item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:50 HKT 07/Apr/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will continue to bring showers and thunderstorms to southern China today and tomorrow. A fresh and relatively dry easterly airstream will affect the coastal areas of Guangdong midweek this week. With the gradual strengthening of an anticyclone aloft in the latter part of this week, the weather will be mainly fine and hot over the coast of Guangdong.

Date/Month: 07/04 (Sunday)
Wind: East to southeast force 3 to 4, occasionally force 5 offshore at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. Showers will be heavier with isolated thunderstorms in the morning.
Temp range: 23 - 27 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium
